# ClickUp

## Addresses

- Sign in: `https://app.clickup.com/login`

## How it behaves

- It runs on the browser session. Stay in the same tab after signing in.
- If links keep trying to open the desktop app, turn off `Detect Desktop App` in settings, or quit the desktop app.
- Get around with search and the command bar rather than digging through the sidebar.
- For a particular task, copy the task URL you're on and reuse it. Don't guess it from ids.

## Keys

| Action | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| Home / Inbox / Dashboards | `H` / `I` / `D` |
| List / board / calendar view | `L` / `B` / `C` |
| Team view | `X` |
| Search or command bar | `S` or `Cmd/Ctrl+K` |
| New task | `T` |
| Close a task or window | `Escape` |
| Status | `Shift+S` |
| Comment | `Shift+M` |
| Due date | `Shift+D` |
| Assignee / assign to me | `Shift+A` / `M` |
| Subtask | `Shift+T` |
| Priority | `Shift+P` |
| Timer | `Shift+.` |
| Move between lists | `Ctrl+Shift+Left/Right` |

In the Inbox:

| Action | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| All | `Shift+A` |
| Primary or Important | `Shift+P` (4.0), `Shift+I` (3.0) |
| Other / Snoozed / Cleared | `Shift+O` / `Shift+Z` / `Shift+C` |
| Open a notification | `O` or `Enter` |
| Next / previous | `J` / `K` |
| Details sidebar | `]` |
| Refresh | `Space` |
| Clear or unclear | `E` |
| Snooze | `Z` |
| Mark unread or read | `U` |
